summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package ships a beacon.cjs that collects installer host identifiers (os.hostname(), install path, process.cwd(), Node version) and POSTs them as JSON to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc over plain HTTP. This beacon fires from two triggers: (1) the package.json postinstall script `node beacon.cjs`, which executes on `npm install` without user interaction, and (2) the declared `main` (index.js), which calls `require('./beacon.cjs').fire()` at top level so merely importing the package re-sends the beacon. index.js exports a Proxy of no-op getters to prevent downstream bundlers/consumers from crashing on the empty module, allowing the exfiltration path to complete silently. The destination is a bare IPv4 address with no TLS, unrelated to any registry or publisher infrastructure.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
